text.en: Pet owners warmly praise the veterinary practitioners and nursing team at Rouken Glen Veterinary Surgery in Thornliebank. Clients highlight named staff members including Dermot, Helen, and Alannah for their diligence, clinical skill, and compassionate communication. Reviewers emphasize that the clinicians conduct thorough investigations into complex conditions rather than rushing to generic solutions.

Clients frequently remark on the genuine compassion and affection shown towards visiting dogs and cats. Pet parents share that veterinarians prioritize animal wellbeing above all else, ensuring nervous or distressed pets feel calm during consultations. Reviewers credit the clinical team with saving unwell pets through dedicated nursing, meticulous diagnostics, and tailored dietary recovery plans.

Reviewers appreciate the surgery honest, transparent approach to veterinary pricing and treatment options. Clients note that clinicians care about animal health rather than maximizing profits, focusing on sensible medical solutions without unnecessary upsells. Longstanding pet owners value receiving high quality clinical treatment at fair, reasonable rates for their companion animals.

q.en: Does Rouken Glen Veterinary Surgery offer home visits?

a.en: Yes, clients mention that the practice provides a mobile veterinary service for pets that find visiting the clinic stressful.

q.en: Are parking facilities available at the surgery?

a.en: Yes, the surgery at East Lodge on Rouken Glen Road has on-site parking accessible for visiting clients.
Emergency veterinary coverage outside regular consulting hours is provided in partnership with Vets Now.
